question.text: For shortages in Block window and TFT segment, the close-out is calculated as:

answer.text: Highest price across exchanges on T day till settlement minus one day OR 20% above settlement price on T day, whichever is higher
Last traded price on T day plus 10%

explanation.text: The Logic: For Block and TFT shortages, close-out is at the highest price (T day to settlement-1 day) or 20% above settlement price on T day, whichever is higher. The Trap: These segments have direct close-out without auction - the close-out formula differs from regular securities.
